mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, i.instance_id AS instanceId, i.bus_id AS busId, i.status AS instanceStatus, d.bus_type AS busType, d.proc_code AS procCode FROM wf_task t INNER JOIN wf_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.instance_id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition d ON i.proc_def_id = d.proc_def_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.instance_id AS instanceId, t.node_id AS nodeId, t.candidate_type AS candidateType, t.candidate_id AS candidateId, t.handler_id AS handlerId, t.action AS action, t.opinion AS opinion, t.is_done AS isDone, t.create_time AS createTime, t.finish_time AS finishTime, i.proc_def_id AS instanceProcDefId, i.bus_id AS instanceBusId, i.starter_id AS instanceStarterId, i.start_time AS instanceStartTime, i.end_time AS instanceEndTime, i.status AS instanceStatus, i.closed_by AS instanceClosedBy, i.close_reason AS instanceCloseReason, i.title AS instanceTitle FROM wf_task t INNER JOIN wf_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.instance_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.is_done = 0 AND i.status = 'APPROVING'
